sentence_stem: Had the committee been informed earlier,
correct_completion: the outcome would almost certainly have differed.
full_sentence: Had the committee been informed earlier, the outcome would almost certainly have differed.
acceptable_variants: the result would probably have been different.
the decision would have been reversed.

options.text: the committee was already aware of it.
options.why_wrong: This states a past fact and does not complete the hypothetical meaning of 'Had ... been informed', which describes an unreal situation.

options.text: so it made no difference at all.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result of facts already given, not the unreal result that the inverted conditional requires.

options.text: the outcome would almost certainly have differed.
they will inform the board tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: A future tense cannot complete a third conditional, which needs 'would have' plus a past participle in the main clause.

explanation: Without 'if', the auxiliary moves to the front of the clause. The main clause must then use 'would have' plus the past participle to express a result that did not happen in the past.
translation: Se o comitê tivesse sido informado mais cedo, o resultado quase certamente teria sido diferente.
